main.description: Returns current indexed like and repost counts for a list of subject records. No authentication is required. Counts are distinct publisher DIDs and match subject.uri regardless of CID or whether the subject is indexed.

subjects.description: Pass 1–100 full DID-authority subject record AT-URIs as repeated, unbracketed subjects query parameters.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The subjects list is empty, has more than 100 entries, or contains an invalid subject AT-URI; correct the list and retry.

errors.name: ReactionCountQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed like or repost count query failed; retry the request.

subject.description: Subject AT-URI requested by the caller; matching ignores the subject CID.

likeCount.description: Number of distinct indexed publisher DIDs with a current like whose subject.uri matches this URI; zero when no matching likes are indexed.

repostCount.description: Number of distinct indexed publisher DIDs with a current repost whose subject.uri matches this URI; zero when no matching reposts are indexed.

counts.description: One entry for each requested subject, in request order. Repeated input URIs produce repeated entries. Counts reflect current indexed state and may change between requests.
